widgets.text:
Chasers score with the Quaffle (10 points).
Beaters hit Bludgers.
Keeper guards the hoops.
Seeker: catching the Golden Snitch ends the match (+150).

widgets.text:
Pass to build the combo meter for special moves.
Build a lead before the Snitch: a big gap makes the catch less risky.
